items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: And we took Sister Kate. And just used the chords, but I was on and voiced it down.

ctx.x: Did anybody play clarinet with you regularly? No, that fella playing the clarinet.

Well, I will tell you now, after I got to tell you about that story, after we rehearsing those numbers down, and David Jones, we took certain numbers. I can't tell, I can tell you the name. And made, and used our own ideas that were based on certain numbers, like Sensation and Ray. That was called, our own, it was called another name. And we took Sister Kate. And just used the chords, but I was on and voiced it down. Didn't use the melody. You see, everybody was doing that in those days. You see? And, um, that…
